label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: The page presents a Coinbase Wallet SDK dialog asking the user to connect by scanning a QR code with their Coinbase Wallet app.

The page copy states that the 'project rectification protocol (PRP) will define a test transaction to perform activities required on chain and does not have real effects on accounts connected', a deceptive claim to trick users into signing a transaction that may drain funds.
The page disables right-click and keyboard shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I, etc.) to prevent user inspection, a common technique used by malicious sites.

label: big-data-login.vercel.app
title: Big Data 2.0
reasons: Bundled JavaScript strings include OTP verification fields and prompts: '/verificar-otp', 'Please enter OTP character', and 'Ingresa el código OTP enviado a:', indicating a form that collects one-time passwords from the visitor.
The page uses EmailJS (api.emailjs.com) as a client-side email relay, which can exfiltrate collected OTP data to an attacker-controlled mailbox without server-side verification.
The dossier signals 'cred_field' and 'exfil_mail' confirm the presence of a credential-harvesting field and email-based exfiltration, landing on the visitor who enters the OTP.

label: idbonusdana.vercel.app
